title: Biodiversity ID Signpost
description: Verified catalogue of 736 British and Irish wildlife identification guides rescued from the Field Studies Council legacy archive.

entries.description: All 736 Catalog Entries. Check web_link when web_link_state is ok, alternative_link when broken, or wayback_link for Internet Archive snapshots.

entry_formats.description: Normalised distribution formats (App, Online, PDF, Publication) linked to entries by title.

entry_additional_links.description: Extra links extracted from resource descriptions.

search_working_guides.title: Search live and recovered guides
search_working_guides.description: Full-text search across working original guides and confirmed Alternatives (leave q blank to list all).
search_working_guides.sql: SELECT wg.title, wg.authors, wg.formats, CASE wg.is_free WHEN 1 THEN 'Free' WHEN 0 THEN 'Paid' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS price, wg.best_link, wg.link_source, wg.wayback_link, wg.keywords FROM working_guides AS wg WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(:q), ''), '') = '' OR wg.id IN (SELECT id FROM entries_fts WHERE entries_fts MATCH :q) ORDER BY wg.title;

free_online_and_pdf_guides.title: Free Online and PDF identification guides
free_online_and_pdf_guides.description: Zero-cost resources available directly online or as PDF downloads with verified live links.
free_online_and_pdf_guides.sql: SELECT DISTINCT wg.title, wg.authors, wg.formats, wg.best_link, wg.link_source, wg.wayback_link, wg.keywords FROM working_guides AS wg JOIN entry_formats AS ef ON ef.entry_id = wg.id WHERE wg.is_free = 1 AND ef.format IN ('Online', 'PDF') ORDER BY wg.title;

link_health_summary.title: Link health and recovery summary
link_health_summary.description: Counts by verification state alongside confirmed Alternatives and Wayback Machine coverage.
link_health_summary.sql: SELECT COALESCE(web_link_state, 'unlinked') AS state, COUNT(*) AS entries, SUM(CASE WHEN alternative_link IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_alternative, SUM(CASE WHEN wayback_link IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_wayback FROM entries GROUP BY COALESCE(web_link_state, 'unlinked') ORDER BY entries DESC;

recovered_alternatives_by_domain.title: Broken links and recoveries by host
recovered_alternatives_by_domain.description: Groups broken Catalog Entries by original host and shows how many gained a confirmed Alternative.
recovered_alternatives_by_domain.sql: WITH broken AS (SELECT web_link, alternative_link, substr(web_link, instr(web_link, '://') + 3) AS after_scheme FROM entries WHERE web_link_state = 'broken' AND web_link IS NOT NULL), hosts AS (SELECT lower(CASE WHEN instr(after_scheme, '/') > 0 THEN substr(after_scheme, 1, instr(after_scheme, '/') - 1) ELSE after_scheme END) AS host, alternative_link FROM broken) SELECT host, COUNT(*) AS broken_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN alternative_link IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recovered FROM hosts GROUP BY host ORDER BY broken_entries DESC, host;
